title: Celebration Hub Halloween 2026
description:
I'm running the Halloween 2026 event for Celebration Hub on Farcaster, Base and X, and I want to see it out in the wild.

What to do:
1. Go to https://celebration-hub.xyz/halloween
2. Send a Halloween gift to a friend, or mint a Halloween card ($2.50, 200 numbered cards).
3. Post a photo, screenshot or short video of it on Farcaster or X. Tag @duckfacts.eth on Farcaster, or @celebrationhb on X.
4. Submit your post link and a screenshot as proof.
5. You can also use the Celebration Hub agents for free.

More information on how it works and about the event itself:
https://farcaster.xyz/duckfacts.eth/0x022c9168
https://x.com/altagers/status/2116239093860299025?a=pXQjN5PN-EjmQCrY1Ic
https://celebration-hub.xyz/halloween

What counts:
- Original content only: your own gift, card, meme or short clip.
- The Halloween gift or card must be visible in the proof.
- One submission per person.

Deadline: Nov 2, 2026, 23:59 UTC.

After the deadline I'll pick my favorite entries and pay them out. 

I'm considering additional bonuses for using the agent and actively sending gifts through the app.

Have fun!

claims.title: Black-cat Halloween gift delivered free via @joysender + a haunted pumpkin village
claims.description:
Halloween 2026 on Celebration Hub — done the free-agent way, zero spend.

• Sent the black-cat Halloween gift to my friend @kmacb.eth through @joysender, Celebration Hub's own free agent — the agent path the bounty itself points to. The bot created and delivered the gift on Base; the gift and its delivery are in the attached screenshot.
• Also did the event's third activity: got us haunted into a pumpkin village with the bot.
• All original: my casts, my gift, my screenshots. A real gift to a real friend, in public — exactly the kind of small onchain moment Celebration Hub is built for.
